models.name: Gemma 4 26B A4B

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash

_sampling_source: Values from each model's Hugging Face card (best-practice / recommended sampling sections). Models whose card gives no recommendation have empty sampling and use llama.cpp's defaults.
_vision_source: Vision models ship mmproj-*.gguf projectors (checked on Hugging Face); llama.cpp downloads the one closest in quantization when --no-mmproj is not passed.
_sizes_source: sizeBytes for added models = the files llama.cpp picks for repo:quant (model + projector), from the Hugging Face tree API; minVramMB = that size + 1.5 GB for context, rounded up to 512 MB.
_draft_source: draft: a smaller model of the same family (same tokenizer) used for speculative decoding (--spec-draft-hf with --spec-type draft-simple, common/arg.cpp). Not on qwen3.5-2b: measured on a 4-core CPU, the 0.8B draft halved its speed in free Arabic text (12.5 -> 6.3 tok/s); on the 4B it doubled speed on copied code (5.7 -> 12.9) but slowed free Arabic text (5.6 -> 3.6).
